headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Gains Breathing Room As A Major Studio Merger Closes
headlines.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) faces a newly enlarged rival after the Paramount and Warner Bros merger closed recently. The combined Paramount and Warner Bros group enters streaming with substantial debt and plans for sizeable cost reductions. Market attention has shifted to how the merged studio will balance integration, content spend and debt repayment against Netflix’s established position.

headlines.title: Are Rising Live Sports Costs a Margin Threat to Netflix Stockholders?
headlines.summary: NFLX's rising live sports costs are testing margin expansion as rights spending outpaces amortization and sports deliver limited viewing hours.

headlines.title: NFLX Price Predictions 2027: How Netflix Stock Could Hit $100 Next Year
headlines.summary: BMO Capital Markets expects Netflix to double over the next year, while Wells Fargo sees it dropping another 15%. While NFLX might not double next year, it has the potential to rise to $100 given its reasonable valuation.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
